summary: Table 1 and the archived DESeq2 notebook report two discoveries for 16-hour hypothalamic HFD versus chow, but neither the genes nor their statistics were located in the public sources searched. The registered edgeR-QL result has zero FDR discoveries and includes an HFD library the authors excluded. Gene-level agreement remains unassessed.

manualReview.summary: The public hypothalamus result gives a discovery count without gene identities
manualReview.note: The deposited count matrix matches the authors' specimen-named matrix across 57,010 gene rows. The 12 registered count columns resolve to six chow and six HFD hypothalamus libraries despite repeated GEO headers. The authors' run-0010 HY DESeq2 fit used six chow, five HFD and five fasted libraries. It excluded HFD specimen S0010_13_HFD_HY, retained by the registered analysis. Table 1 and the Zenodo notebook report two genes at adjusted P < 0.05. The saved summary gives no gene IDs, effects or per-gene statistics. The registered edgeR-QL table has zero FDR discoveries among 21,906 published symbols. See data/author-validation/continued-sources/GSE236077/codex-2026-11-21/SEARCH_LOG.md and review.json.
reviewFlags: This legacy source has no committed source-file checksum manifest.
The registered two-arm fit retains S0010_13_HFD_HY (true HY accession GSM7517859, registered count label GSM7517883). The authors excluded it for PCA and fitted fasting jointly with the diet arms.
The public discovery count supplies no gene-level reference for effect or inference concordance.

verificationReview.reason: The article, figure assets, all GEO sample supplement records and both series files, the archived author notebooks, repository histories and public repository searches yielded only a discovery count for this contrast. The count cannot establish gene identity, direction, effect size or P/FDR agreement.
verificationReview.nextStep: Obtain the authors' original run-0010 HY HFD-versus-chow DESeq2 table with Ensembl IDs, log2 fold changes, P values and adjusted P values. Use the recorded specimen crosswalk and account for the excluded HFD library and joint three-diet fit before interpreting a comparison.
